release_notes: MBT POS v3.1.5 makes clicking the MBT POS icon behave predictably. Only one copy of MBT POS ever runs: if it is already open, the icon brings that window back to the front instead of starting a second copy. Clicking again while MBT POS is still opening does nothing disruptive and never shows a warning. If a copy is running with no window on screen, MBT POS now explains how to close it and start again instead of closing in silence. Also carries everything from v3.1.4: Internal Consumption is fully integrated on desktop and the web dashboard, with multi-product selection, department management, clickable history showing every product used, and buying cost, average buying cost, retail opportunity value and foregone gross profit. Preserves AppData identity, license state and mbt_pos.db.
